evidence: mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/navigation/Navigation.kt:452 — CreateListing screen is wired into the production nav graph (reachable via MyListings → CreateListing), but its onSubmit is a stub returning Result.failure(NotImplementedError("Wire to listing API")); every listing-creation submit silently fails in production with no backing API call.

mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/api/HttpClientProvider.kt:37 — the shared HttpClient installs only ContentNegotiation + Logging and no HttpTimeout plugin; a stalled connection has no request/socket timeout, so a suspend call (e.g. ListingDetailViewModel.loadListing) can hang indefinitely leaving the screen's spinner spinning with no error surfaced, and isNetworkError()'s timeout hints never trigger.

mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/auth/SsoService.kt — 348-line auth/session core (createMobileToken, validateAndLogin, loginWithPassword, restoreSession, session-token storage, 401→logout handling) has no test file anywhere; token handling and the Unauthorized-triggers-logout branches are entirely uncovered, a security-sensitive path.
